what: Right behind the heading, a second copy of the same text is laid flat about the baseline (scale 1, .6) as a faint shadow (text color at 30%). With the cursor at the left edge of the screen it lies at 20°, and it lies 1° further for every 20px to the right, stopping at 50° (no easing, it follows the hand directly). Before the cursor moves, 52°. To hide the shadow like a lit panel, set --fx-shadow-on to 0 (.3s)

options.[data-fx-part=shadow]: Shadow text (child) — the same text as the attached element, once more with aria-hidden
options.div: How many px of cursor movement add 1° of tilt, default 20
options.--fx-drop: Distance to lift the shadow above the baseline (css), default 3px
options.--fx-shadow: Shadow color (css), default 30% of text color
options.--fx-shadow-on: Shadow visibility (css, 0~1) — changing it fades on and off over .3s

note: On devices without hand input or with reduced motion it stays at the initial tilt (52°). Since text isn’t split, the attached shadow element keeps the same width so multi-line titles wrap at the same spot as their shadows

from.where: index.html all headings .sh-h — original .shades (color rgba(0,0,0,.3) · skew(52deg) scale(1,.6) · transform-origin bottom center) + on mousemove skew(min(clientX/20+20, 50)deg) scale(1, .6)
